description: Find a ready-made task (a 'recipe') on a website, e.g. 'apartments for rent in Austin', 'pizza dough recipe', 'second-hand bikes in Berlin', 'jobs for data engineers in Munich'. Any language. Returns the best matches that run here, each with params_schema, output_schema and example_params; then call `run`. `local_only` lists matches that need the user's own browser (login, booking, or a site that blocks servers). If nothing fits, call `request_recipe`.

country.description: Optional two-letter country code (DE, GB, US …). Without it, a country or big city named in the task filters the results.

site.description: Optional site name or domain to restrict the search, e.g. 'zillow.com'

task.description: What the user wants to do, in their words

name: find_recipe
title: Find a recipe
